summary_markdown: A technical issue was discussed regarding an Angular template binding error (`NG5002: Unsupported expression in a two-way binding`) on the line `<mat-select [(value)]="+\text{cur\_frame.frame\_status\_id}">`. The immediate fix suggested was to remove the plus sign from the binding. This change resolved the compilation error, allowing the work to proceed.
decisions: The Angular template binding syntax was corrected by removing the '+' symbol.
